CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  REGULAR  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY,  DECEMBER  10, 2024

CALL  TO ORDER  Gil Hurtado,  Mayor  called  a Regular  City  Council  Meeting  to order  at
  6:34 p.m.

INVOCATION  Tina De La Rosa, Deputy  Director  of Parks & Recreation

PLEDGE  OFALLEGIANCE  Flavio  Morales,  Tweedy  Mile  Advisory  Board  Member

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor  Gil Hurtado,  Vice  Mayor  Maria  Davila,  Council  Member  Maria  del
  Pilar Avalos,  Council  Member  Joshua Barron  and Council  Member  Al
  Rios;  City Treasurer  Jose De La Paz, City  Manager  Rob Houston,  City
  Attomey  Raul F. Salinas

ELECTION  ADMIN  The City  Council  unanimously  adopted  Resolution  No. 2024-80-CC
  entitled  A Resolution  of the City  Council  of the City  of South Gate,
  California,  reciting  the facts of the General  Municipal  Election  held on
  Tuesday,  November  5, 2024, and declaring  the results  and such other
  matters  as provided  by law, by motion  of Vice Mayor  Davila  and seconded
  by Mayor  Hurtado.

  ROLL  CALL:  Council  Member  Avalos,  yes; Council  Member  Barron,
  yes; Council  Member  Rios, yes; Vice Mayor  Davila,  yes; Mayor  Hurtado,
  yes.

ELECTIONADMIN  The City  Council  unanimously  authorized  the administration  of the Oath
  of Office  (by ballot  order)  to the re-elected  City  officials  elected  from  the
  General  Municipal  Election  on November  5, 2024:

  a. City  Council  Member,  Maria  R. Davila;
  b. City  Council  Member,  Gil Hurtado;
  c. City  Council  Member,  Maria  del Pilar Avalos.

3
COUNCIL

  a.  Re-organized  by nominating  and selecting  a new Mayor  and Vice

  vote of the City  Council;  and

  Mario  Dominguez,  resident  is upset  at the result  of the recent  elections.
ITEMS

  Ask  Vice  Mayor  Davila  to resign  to allow  Franbert  Calderon  to join  the

  Sophie  Ryan,  resident  is happy  with  the results  of this  elections  and wants

  everyone  to know  that  Maria  Davila  spends  so much  time  in the schools'

  helping  students  and parents.

  Lizette  Ruiz,  a Kauffman  resident  congratulates  council  on their  re-

  elections  and for always  helping  our community.

  Yvonne,  a resident  who  would  like  to thank  Maria  Davila  for her

  involvement  in our community,  assisted  our city  to build  new  schools,

  supported  the Azalea  Shopping  Center.  During  the pandemic  she

  distributed  food  to our needy  families.  She collaborates  and is very  active

  in various  organizations.

  MariaNavarro,  9411  SanAntonio  resident  and would  like  to thank  Maria

  Davila  for her being  present  and even when  she is ill.  Ms.  Davila,  Mr.

  Hurtado,  Mr.  Barron,  and Mr. Al thank  you  for your  leadership.

  Leticia  Vasquez-Wilson,  Director  of Central  Basin  Municipal  Water

  District.  Congratulations  Mayor  Hurtado,  Maria  Davila  and thank  you  for

  your  work.  Also,  to Maria  Del  Pilar  Avalos.

ITEMS  Luis  Gerardo  Cuellar/Lorraine  Avila  Moore.  Council  Members  from  City
  of Lynwood,  presenting  certificates  of appreciation  to the three (3)  re-

  elected  council  members.  A special  thank  you to Council  Member  Avalos
  who also served the City  of Lynwood.

  Residents  from  Garfield  Avenue  recently  filed  a complaint  and thanks
  Maria  Del Pilar Avalos  for assisting  them  in this matter.

  Maria  Diaz,  resident  and would  like to congratulate  Maria  Del Pilar
  Avalos  for always  supporting  the community.

  Carmen  Avalos,  congratulations  to Pilar, very proud,  for your  contribution,
  continue  making  changes,  congratulations  to the council  members,  would
  have liked  less mudslinging  which  typically  happens  in South  Gate, and
  disappointed  with  the irregularities  with  this election.

  Claudia,  Executive  Director  from  Casa Sonora.  Congratulations  to each
  one of you on your re-election.  Proud  of you and look forward  to working
  with  you. Keep up the good work.

  44f'l Congressional  District  representative  on behalf  Nanette  Diaz
  Barragan  congratulated  council  members  for their re-elections.  Presented
  council  members  with  certificates.

  Mario  Dominguez,  Resident  is upset at the result  of the recent  elections.

  Ruben  Pichardo,  Resident  is reporting  issues regarding  employee  Johanna
  making  up violation  codes to harass me since August  1, 2024.  Requesting
  assistance  to correct  this issue.

  Armando  Velasquez,  Kiwanis  announces  the Clean-up  and brunch  event at
  Casa Abuelita.  Bingo  Lottery  Night.  Food  and Gi'[t Card Drive.

  Armando  Velasquez,  Resident  is not happy  that this year's  election  process
  did not include  Q&A's,  and independent  interviews.

  Ana,  Chamber  of Commerce  announces  future  events for November  and
  December.

  Council  Member  Avalos  asked if parking  will  be allowed  on the Northside
  of Southern  Avenue  during  the Christmas  Parade.

  Darren  Arakawa,  Police  Chief  states that parking  will  not be allowed
  during  the parade.

REPORTS  AND  COMMENTS

FROMCITYOFFICIALS  ArturoCervantes,DirectorofPublicWorksprovidesaCIPProject
  construction,  renovation  and resurfacing  updates.

  Steve  Costley,  Director  of Parks  & Recreation  thanks  residents  and

  community  for their  attendance  during  Halloween  Night  & Special

  Olympics  events.

  Meredith  Elguira,  Director  of Community  Development  responds  to Mr.

  Pichardo's  comments.  Currently,  looking  into  his allegations.  Also,

  looking  into  expediting  the process  for the Dominoe's  expansion.

  Wendy  O'Kelly,  Director  of Administrative  Services  provides  update  that

  staff  is currently  working  on the Annual  Comprehensive  Financial  Report.

  Nelly  Cobos,  Deputy  Director  of Human  Resources  urges  the public  to go

  to our city's  website  for job  opportunities.

  Darren  Arakawa,  Police  Chief  thanks  community  and council  for their

  attendance  at the Family  Day  at the Park.  Received  great  feedback.

  Rob  Houston,  City  Manager  was able to participate  in the Halloween,

  Veterans  Day,  and Family  Day  at the Park  events  and appreciates  the

  community  participation.

  Raul  F. Salinas,  City  Attorney  has nothing  to report.

  Jose De La Paz, City  Treasurer  has nothing  to report.

  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk  has nothing  to report.

REPORTS  AND  COMMENTS
FROM  CITY  OFFICIALS

CONT'D  Council  MemberAvalos  thanks  the community  for their participation  in

  this year's  elections.  Attended  Family  Day at the Park. Appreciated  the
  hard work  of the Police  Dept. during  the Trunk  or Treat event.

  Council  Member  Rios congratulations  council  members  for this election
  and those who participated.  Attended  Family  Day at the Park and enjoyed
  seeing  all who attended.  Thank  you, Veterans  and their families.

  Would  like to ask the Chief  about the new administration  and worries
  regarding  our immigrant  community.

  Darren  Arakawa,  Chief  of Police  states that we do not enforce  immigration
  laws. Not our jurisdiction.  We do not ask immigration  status. We will
  arrest those that cornrnit  crimes  in our community.

  Council  Member  Barron  honored  to attend the Veteran's  Day event.
  Attended  Family  Day at the Park. Thank  you to the organizations  that
  participated  in our events.  Looking  forward  to Breakfast  with  Santa.

  Vice Mayor  Davila  announces  the Power  Gateway  $8,000  rebate meetings
  November  16, 2024,  and November  19, 2024. Thank  you to Steve Costley
  and his staff for amazing  events.

  Thank  you to detective  Sarah Medrano  and Tony  Mendez  on the Fentanyl
  Presentation  for South  Gate Middle  School  parents.

  Mayor  Gil Hurtado  attended  meeting  with  elected  officials  regarding
  ISSUES with  broadband.

  Thank  you to our South  Gate employees  for making  sure our events  are
  safe for our community.

  Responds  to Mr. Pichardo's  comments.  I try my best to bring  back
  anyone's  issues to our staff. We strive  to do everything  we can to assist our
  community.

  Elections  are stressful  but we offer  our commitment  to our community.  We
  might  have differences,  but we will  respect  the vote of the people.
